Overall canvas 1536x512, lettering fills width with small safe margins. Genuine transparent alpha background including the counters of letters, no checkerboard baked in, no parchment, no backdrop, no ornament, no underline, no extra text. Every letter complete and easily legible. Intended to sit on near-black page.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate the EMPTY parchment ground for a fourth antique natural-history plate. The reference paintings are style and color references ONLY. Remove all illustrations, letters, plants, seabed and ornaments: nothing drawn anywhere. A flat uninterrupted aged parchment surface, warm cream at the broad center, nuanced fine paper fibers, subdued mottling and foxing, darkening softly through ochre and umber to near-black (#070402) on ALL FOUR EDGES. Heavy oval vignette matching the reference paintings; edges seamlessly nearly black, substantial luminous central area occupying 70 percent of width and height. NO frame or visible physical paper boundary, no cracks, no burn holes, no writing, no forms or illustrations. Landscape canvas exactly 2048x1280, fully opaque. This will be the calm background behind separate engraved animal and text cutouts.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a very wide low horizontal strip of ancient seabed cut from the bottom of the reference natural-history painting. Style reference only: hand-coloured antique copperplate engraving with fine dense black crosshatching and stipple, muted ochre rocks, slate gray rubble, sage patches, dusty-red encrusting coral, two little scallop shells, small sea urchins, squat ochre sponges. All elements SMALL, subdued and low, continuous rocky shelf across the full width, no large hero object. Landscape strip aspect ratio 16:3, requested final canvas 2048x384. Lower part dense fine sand and rubble, irregular upper silhouette with a gentle fade into GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA above and between the highest stones, no opaque background, no checkerboard artwork. No creatures swimming, no tall plants, no text. Soft subtle offset shadow directly under rocks. Canvas subject must read as one continuous shelf spanning from left edge to right edge, as a footer below separate animals.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied seabed illustration: REMOVE ALL gray-and-white checkerboard pixels from above and below the shelf, replacing them with REAL TRANSPARENCY in the PNG alpha channel. The checkerboard is an error, it must not appear in the exported image. Preserve the entire illustrated shelf exactly, all rocks, shells, tiny sponges, muted hand-coloured engraving detail, the gentle under-shadow. Tight crop to the low wide shelf's bounding rectangle with small transparent margin above; preserve its natural wide proportions. No new illustrations, no typography, no solid backdrop. Output actual transparent PNG cutout.

Edit this seabed strip. Replace the entire checkerboard backdrop with PERFECTLY PURE SOLID WHITE (#FFFFFF), both above and below the illustrated shelf. No checks, no gray backdrop, no paper, no texture in white background. Preserve the continuous low rocky shelf, its shells, sponges, encrusting coral and urchins in exactly the same antique engraving style and muted colors. Remove the cast shadow. Cutout reference on pure solid white. Wide 2048x384 framing, close crop to shelf with 5 percent white margin above and below.
